mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 5% indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL rises above 5% and S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of the subsequent 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3% signals a tight labor market, which may lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 3% and S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of the subsequent 60-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of the subsequent 5-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 2% YoY signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY growth exceeds 2% and S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of the subsequent 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5%, and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy coupled with slow economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the conditions are met and S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of the subsequent 60-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000 and S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of the subsequent 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: When real estate loans (RSAFS) increase by more than 10% YoY and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it indicates strong consumer demand and confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the conditions are met and S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of the subsequent 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) below -2% YoY signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY growth is below -2% and S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of the subsequent 60-day periods.
